_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment: never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Links a customer record to the supplier record of the same organisation, so the invoices sent to and received from it can be shown together. RelationLinkService writes the link only after a user confirms it, and refuses a supplier that another customer is linked to already.

payeeId.title: Supplier record
payeeId.description: The supplier record of the same organisation, when this customer is also a supplier.

payeeLink.title: Supplier link
payeeLink.description: How the link to the supplier record was made and who confirmed it.

matchedOn.title: Matched on
matchedOn.description: The equal number that suggested the link, or manual for a link made by hand.

confirmedBy.title: Confirmed by
confirmedBy.description: The user who confirmed the link.

dismissedPayeeSuggestions.title: Dismissed supplier suggestions
dismissedPayeeSuggestions.description: Supplier records a user said are not this customer, so they are not suggested again.
